notes: Variant v017 is a selected unit over ἐστίν and leaves the projection unchanged.
The ASV's note that many authorities insert 16:25-27 here affects no token of this verse.

The supplied he eateth is added as a resumed verb whose token φάγῃ has already spent its English (rules 5, 103); rule 62's second arm reaches the same answer, ἐκ πίστεως being written in full. Reading it as a discontinuous second realization under rule 15 remains defensible.

πᾶν ὅ is joined as one aligned unit on whatsoever under rule 39's test; rule 80's competing reading, which empties the second token, rests on an article supplying only a pronoun and does not carry to a relative.
